actions.description: Controls inside a section, in a row or a column.

gap.description: The gap between the controls: a spacing token or px.

items.description: The controls, shaped as a segment's.

min_w.description: The floor of the one width every `button` takes: the widest label over every variant, at least this.

max.description: The newest app release this package renders correctly on.

min.description: The oldest app release this package renders correctly on.

band.description: One band of the HUD block.

cells.description: The band's cells; cells of one alignment pack left to right in array order.

chrome.description: While a scrub is live a `fades` band draws on the chrome alpha and a `steady` one at full alpha. The band holding the `playbar` must be `steady`.

gap.description: The gap between the band's packed cells: a spacing token or px.

gap_before.description: The gap to the previous PRESENT neighbour, in place of the stack's own: a spacing token or px.

id.description: The band's name, unique in the package: `up_next.band` and lint findings name it.

when.description: Present only while the condition(s) hold: a condition name, or an array that must all hold, each optionally prefixed `!`. An absent element collapses as an absent control does.

z.description: Draw and hit-test order among bands: a higher band is above a lower one.

card.description: A strip card: its art, what is drawn over it and what stands under it. `item.*` bindings and conditions are legal only inside it.

below_gap.description: The gap between the art and the cells below: a spacing token or px.

overlay.description: Cells drawn over the art, positioned by their `align` and `valign`.

crop.description: How the image fills the card.

cell.description: A cell of a band (or of a vstack, a rect or a strip card): its position keys and exactly one of the twelve cell kinds. The scrub group, segments, the strip and actions are focus stops, so the compiler refuses them inside a strip card.

actions.description: Controls inside a section, in a row or a column.

align.description: Which edge the cell packs against in its band (a strip card's cells omit it).

facts.description: The facts run: duration, year, genres, rating and badges, fitted as chips.

gap_before.description: The gap to the previous PRESENT neighbour, in place of the stack's own: a spacing token or px.

icon.description: An asset glyph tinted by an ink.

image.description: A bound image through the image cache.

playbar.description: The scrub bar with its clocks and knob: exactly one per package.

segment.description: One row of controls: a focus group.

valign.description: Where the cell stands against the band's height. Absent: the compiler's choice.

when.description: Present only while the condition(s) hold: a condition name, or an array that must all hold, each optionally prefixed `!`. An absent element collapses as an absent control does.

badges.description: The badge chips, in order: an ordered subset. `content_rating` is in `order` or `badges`, never both.

genres_max.description: How many genres the run shows at most.

ink.description: A theme token or a palette name.

order.description: The plain facts, in order: an ordered subset.

playback_fact.description: Whether the playback fact is drawn, regular in `TEXT_TERTIARY`.

grab.description: The playbar's pointer grab band, registered as the lowest stop.

above.description: Px of grab area above the track's top edge.

below.description: Px of grab area below the track's bottom edge.

oneOf.description: Play or pause; also the Play, Pause and PlayPause keys and OK on the picture.

layout.description: Where the HUD sits and what it holds.

anchor.description: Where the HUD is anchored. Only `bottom` in 1.0 (D13): a top HUD needs a caption keep-out the media layer lacks.

band.description: What lifted captions keep clear of (D8): the control row only, or the whole compact block.

block.description: The bands, top to bottom, in one bottom-anchored stack.

inset.description: The block's distance above the bottom edge of the safe area: a spacing token or px.

scrim.description: The darkening behind the HUD. Absent: none.

sections.description: How the chapters and info sections open (D6): `modal` one at a time, hiding the row; `inline` any subset beside the row.

up_next.description: How the Up Next offer and the Skip pill replace segments of the row (R4: both buttons are placed here).

x_inset.description: The block's distance from the safe area's sides: a spacing token or px.

playbar.description: The scrub bar. Exactly one per package: the scrub group.

clocks.description: `follow_head` classic's clocks that follow the playhead, `ends` clocks at the bar's two ends.

fill.description: The elapsed part's ink: a theme token or a palette name.

grab.description: The pointer grab band around the track.

mark.description: The transport mark: `after_elapsed` beside the elapsed clock, `busy_only` the spinner alone (the paused glyph may go when a `toggle_play` control is placed).

thickness.description: The track's height in px. The bar's box is the track and the line the clocks are drawn on under it, or this if taller; the knob and the mark overhang the track.

track.description: The track's ink: a theme token or a palette name.

w.description: The bar's width in px, or `fill`.

rect.description: A filled panel. Its content box is the ground inset by `pad` and lies inside the safe area; the ground may bleed past it.

bleed.description: Px the ground extends past the safe area, never past the screen. At most `pad`; needs `pad`.

gap.description: The gap between the panel's cells: a spacing token or px.

h.description: A fixed panel height in px, its cells centred in it.

ink.description: The panel's fill: a theme token or a palette name.

pad.description: Px between the ground's edge and its content box, which must lie inside the safe area. A plain number: `bleed` is compared with it.

ink.description: A theme token or a palette name.

cover.description: `block`: the scrim's top follows the compiled block top per state, `extra` px above it. `fixed`: one `height` from the screen bottom in every state, drawn before any band.

extra.description: With `cover: "block"`: px of scrim above the block's top. At most classic's whole scrim height.

height.description: With `cover: "fixed"`: the scrim's height from the screen bottom. At most classic's whole scrim height.

segment.description: One row of controls. The segments of one band form one focus group.

gap.description: The gap between the controls: a spacing token or px.

id.description: The segment's name, unique in the package: `up_next.replaces` names it.

strip.description: The chapters strip: a shelf of cards. Scrolling and seating are app-owned.

focus.description: The focus face of a card.

gap.description: The gap between cards: a spacing token or px.

label_align.description: How a card's labels align: `centre` the shelf's default, or `leading`.

radius.description: A card's corner radius in px.

w.description: The strip's width in px, or `fill`.

text.description: A line of bound text. App-owned text (`label.*`, `item.start`) takes no `w` and no `max_lines`.

bold.description: The bold weight; the app ships two weights.

ink.description: A theme token (upper case) or a palette name (lower case).

leading.description: The line pitch in px, and a one-line text's box height. Absent: the rung's line height.

max_lines.description: 1 elides; more wraps. Server text only (D10).

size.description: A type-scale rung name. `HUD_TITLE` (54 px) is legal only on a text bound to `title.main`.

w.description: The text's width in px, or `fill`. Server text only (D10): app text hugs its measured width.

up_next.description: The Up Next offer. Its inside is app-owned; a package chooses what it replaces, where it stands and how its two buttons look.

align.description: Where the offer's column stands against the replaced segments: `end` at their end edge, `center` on their centre, `start` on their start edge.

band.description: The id of the band the offer is drawn in.

caption.description: Whether the offer draws its caption.

countdown.description: How the auto-advance countdown shows on or in the Play Next button; never absent while running.

replaces.description: The segment ids that leave the frame and the focus map while the offer or the Skip pill shows.

still.description: Whether the offer draws the next episode's still.

up_next_button.description: An Up Next button's looks. Its command is fixed by the app.

focus.description: The focus face: `accent` today's, `ring` the rest face plus the white focus ring. `solid` rest with `accent` focus draws one face twice and is rejected.

rest.description: The resting face: `film` today's, `bare` the glyph only, `solid` the focused colours at rest, `custom` (1.0 defines no ink keys for it: the compiler decides).

gap.description: The gap between the cells: a spacing token or px.

w.description: Width in px, or `fill`. Absent: the widest cell.

description: A HUD package: one UTF-8 JSON file, `*.plxhud.json`, assets inline.

$schema.description: The schema URL, for editors: accepted and ignored by the app; lint checks its major.minor equals `format`.

app.description: The app releases this package renders correctly on.

format.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the schema, bindings and command vocabulary.

id.description: The package's reverse-DNS identity (the built-in HUD's reserved `builtin:classic` is the one other id that parses).

layout.description: Where the HUD sits and what it holds.

palette.description: Named colours: lower-case name -> "#rrggbb". Every entry must be used.

version.description: The package's own semver; it only orders updates of one id.
